node.title: N=512 trinomial interval-norm collision exclusion
node.statement: At N=512,s=2, every folded profile (1,2,0) normalizes to F=2+epsilon X^a+delta X^b with 1<=a<b<=255. The 129540 signed states form 748 odd-Galois orbits and give 746 distinct exact norms. For each norm and both full pair-feasible prime intervals, the complementary-cofactor window has width at most one: only four integers occur, only one divides, and its quotient is composite and 0 mod 512. Thus no pair-feasible prime divides any norm. Together with the four-singleton exclusion, every surviving N=512 collision has s>=3.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: closes the complete N=512,s=2 band by a dual-backend exact resultant and interval-divisor certificate. It does not control s>=3 or the total collision-pair ledger.
